plugins.Author: Akari
plugins.Name: Venue Helper
plugins.Punchline: An all-in-one toolkit for FFXIV venue hosts: attendance, raffles, auctions, giveaways, deathroll tournaments, bar games, menus, and quick announcements.
plugins.Description: An all-in-one venue host toolkit: Venue Counter (multi-venue attendance + lifetime time tracking), Raffle Helper, Auction Helper (gil shorthand + buyer tracking), Giveaway Helper (anti-cheat), DR Tourny Helper (single or double elimination), Shout/Yell Helper, Bar Game Helper (custom + survival games, fixed/tiered/high-score payouts), Menu Helper (per-venue menus, macro serve sequences), plus a Settings tab with backup/restore and a master panic switch. Open with /venuehelper (aliases /vhelp, /vh). Exports to TXT, CSV, PDF, or XLSX.

plugins.Author: Akari
plugins.Name: FC Tracker
plugins.Punchline: Track your characters' Free Companies: level, tag, credits, house, and workshop vessels.
plugins.Description: Records, per character, the Free Company you belong to: name, tag, level, current master, member counts, FC credits, house ownership (district/ward/plot/world), and workshop airships & submersibles with build shorthand. Sortable table with click-to-expand details, a First Registered date, editable founder/house-winner notes, optional shared storage across all clients, and import from AutoRetainer and Submarine Tracker. Open with /fctracker (alias /fct).

plugins.Author: Akari
plugins.Name: Housing Lotto Tracker
plugins.Punchline: Track your housing lottery bids: plot, world, entry number, results date, win/loss.
plugins.Description: Passively records every housing lottery bid you place, per character, by reading the placard when you interact with it. One row per bid: character/world, region, district, ward, plot, size, FC-vs-personal, entry date, results-available date with live countdown, and outcome (Pending/Won/Lost). Auto-captures placard data during entry and results periods; auto-detects wins via the results SelectYesno; entry number is grabbed when shown and editable otherwise. Sortable table with click-to-expand details, per-column toggles, editable notes, and optional shared storage across all clients. Open with /hlt (alias /lotto).

plugins.Author: Akari
plugins.Name: Market Helper
plugins.Punchline: Undercut, list, gather and buy — market board automation end to end.
plugins.Description:
Market Helper is an all-in-one market board tool with five tabs:

UNDERCUT — Walk a summoning bell's retainers and undercut every listed item. HQ and NQ are handled separately, your own retainers are matched rather than undercut, per-item overrides and price memory are supported, an obvious troll price is skipped, and mannequin/display items are never touched (if a row can't be verified it is skipped rather than risk delisting it). Closes the bell when it finishes.

LISTER — Build a list (hold CTRL and hover an item, or search) and press Go to list them all. Prices each item at the most common market price, ignoring lone troll listings, against your world, data center or whole region. Per-item stack sizes and list amounts, rolls extra items to the next retainer at the 20-slot cap, and includes a no-touch dry run.

FLIPPER — Compare any marketable item across Japan, America, Europe and Materia via Universalis. Top 10 listings per region, best cross-region flip, and seller/buyer tax modelling.

ITEM GATHERER — Pull designated items off your retainers into your bags, optionally returning your market listings first. Manual withdraw/deposit actions included.

BUYER — Build a shopping list by hand or import a MakePlace furniture list, then SCAN the market per world via Universalis and press SEND to travel with Lifestream and buy across worlds. Every purchase is verified against the game's own confirmation dialog before it is accepted. Listings are bought whole, so by default it never buys a bigger stack than you still need, and a hard sanity ceiling caps the price even with no cap set. If a planned listing has already been bought it chases the next cheapest, on other worlds if needed, until your order is filled. Dry run is on by default.

Open with /markethelp, /market, /mh, or /undercut.

plugins.Author: Akari
plugins.Name: Consolidator
plugins.Description: Consolidates gil and items from your alt characters onto a single main, and hands items back out from that main to the alts. The alt side logs in, travels via Lifestream, walks to the receiver with vnavmesh, trades over everything above your floors, and returns to the FC. Requires AutoRetainer, Lifestream and vnavmesh; the receiving character can accept trades with Consolidator itself or Dropbox.
plugins.Punchline: Sweep gil from every alt onto one character.

plugins.Author: Akari
plugins.Name: Mahjong Advisor
plugins.Punchline: Discard advice and optional auto-play for Doman Mahjong.
plugins.Description: Reads your Doman Mahjong hand, discards, dora, scores and called melds, then ranks each discard by hand speed against deal-in risk. Auto-play and file logging are on by default in this build: sit at a casual table and it plays, then /mjadv bundle packages the logs for support. /mjadv stop or the Automation tab returns to manual suggestions instantly. Discard piles and meld strips are found automatically; the node tools are only a fallback.
plugins.Changelog: v0.4.4.0: Chi picker freeze fix. When a call prompt's claimed tile could not be identified, the single-shape chi gate counted shapes for the wrong tile: each candidate offered one run, but the actual tile completed two, so the game opened its shape-selection dialog - which ignores call callbacks - and the match froze (live at South 4 while leading 38,400; bundle 20261030-081345). Chi now fires only when the claim is pinned to one tile, or when every tile that could legally be on offer completes exactly one run; anything else passes instead. The picker-stall warning also logs once rather than every frame. The stale Advisor block that earlier builds wrote into the plugin config is no longer serialised: it was never read, is ignored on load, and disappears at the next config save. An experimental rollout-search re-ranking of discard candidates is included but ships OFF: a 240-match paired simulator A/B (two seeds) rejected it - it traded a 39% relative win-rate drop for nothing - so it stays a foundation for later work. v0.4.3.0: Result-screen retry. The result panel can swallow the first advance callback while it animates; the controller fired it twice and then its acted guard blocked every retry, leaving the screen waiting indefinitely (live Advanced freeze, state 29 unresolved for 12s). Advances now retry every 2.5 seconds while the result state persists, capped at 8 attempts so the deliberately manual match-end screen is not spammed. v0.4.2.0: Match-level tuning. A full hanchan evaluator now plays East+South with real score accounting, dealer rotation, honcha, riichi sticks and placement, and 120 paired matches showed the old risk settings were too passive. Win value 1800 and deal-in cost 4000 beat 1300/5200 on identical deals (average place 2.55 vs 2.65, more firsts, fewer fourths) with the deal-in rate unchanged at 9.3%. A v7 config migration applies the new values. Riichi hand value and placement stance were also tested and left unchanged - both were flat across 60-match arms. v0.4.1.0: Advanced-table defence. Cross-seat genbutsu now uses the pond lengths captured at the instant a riichi marker appears; the old turn-count shortcut broke once calls shortened ponds and could mark a tile discarded before the riichi as safe. Two declared riichi also force a fold for any hand that is not tenpai, overriding the placement chase. The simulator now records the same declaration snapshots: over 1,000 hands the defence fix moved deal-in rate from 10.3% to 9.5% and average points from -22 to +17, while the double-riichi rail was neutral there because the simulation has no placement stance. Live Advanced trial on 0.4.0.0 finished 1st, 4th, then leading when stopped; the 4th lost two deal-ins to one riichi player, the second 12,000 while two were in riichi. v0.4.0.0: Exact scoring core. Completed hands are now scored by yaku, fu, dora and the payment table (closed and open, riichi through yakuman), and the offline simulator uses that scoring for win legality and payouts. Ready-hand valuation was built and benchmarked but stays out of live decisions: over 1,500 simulated hands, mixing exact tenpai values with the existing one-away estimate cut the win rate from 15.4% to 8.1%, so the value scale must be unified for every shanten first. Advice is memoised per table state so the overlay and controller do not recompute the same decision. v0.3.10.0: Silent-endgame defence. The threat model measured a silent opponent as at most 19% likely tenpai, so on a table with no riichi and no melds every safety rule stayed off - the controller pushed one-away hands with 6-9 tiles left to draw into damaten twice in one match (4,200 and 2,200 deal-ins) and paid full tsumo on 14,300 and 20,000 hands. Silent seats now take on a readiness floor that rises from zero at wall 32 to a concrete threat at wall 16, arming the existing late-wall fold and per-tile safety ranking on quiet tables. v0.3.9.0: Chi freeze fixed. The shape-selection dialog ignores scripted call picks (confirmed by the first picker dump), so chi now only fires when exactly one shape is possible - that path completes with no dialog. Multi-shape chi passes instead of stalling; the pass log records how many shapes were declined. v0.3.8.0: Late-wall defence. When an opponent is a concrete threat and the wall is down to the last four go-arounds, the controller folds any hand that is not tenpai instead of pushing a 1-shanten no-riichi hand. This was the 12,000 deal-in in the first match. Diagnostic bundles now also include chi picker dumps. The end-of-match results screen still waits for you by design - that is the one click after a match. v0.3.7.0: Chi is now fully automated. The controller calls chi when the advisor ranks it best, and if the client shows the shape-selection surface it fires the first variant and re-evaluates the hand. The picker layout is dumped once per session to the log folder so shape-specific selection can be refined against real captures. A v6 config migration enables chi. v0.3.6.0: Read each opponent meld strip independently. A hidden empty strip for one quiet seat no longer suppresses every visible meld on the table, so the threat model sees called sets when they exist. This is a readiness/defence accuracy change; automation logic is unchanged. v0.3.5.0: Fix the second freeze. A complete open hand is no longer assumed to be a legal tsumo: the controller checks for an actual yaku and keeps discarding when there is none. Call prompts now prefer the newest board addition over a possibly stale pond tile (the live log claimed 6z/dragon while the actual Pon was 9m), and the log records the last discard tile/seat. A v5 config migration re-enables auto-play/logging. v0.3.4.0: Fix the self-kan freeze. A Kan/Pass bar at state 6 is ignored and the normal discard proceeds instead of firing a Pass callback the client ignores. Session stats are preserved after /mjadv stop so the bundle still shows the run, and a v4 config migration re-enables auto-play/logging for the next launch. v0.3.3.0: Reset the exposed tuning sliders to the fitted win-rate defaults (base hand value 1300, deal-in 5200, noten 1500, opponent hand 4000) with a one-time v3 config migration. Diagnostic bundles now include the actual Dalamud plugin config file from pluginConfigs. v0.3.2.0: State 15 is now treated as the generic other-players state unless real call buttons are present, state 22 (forced riichi discard) is automated, and state 27 (between-hands result/score) is recognised instead of showing stale advice. Overlay/advice are now gated to actual decision states, and diagnostic bundles can read the Dalamud log while it is open. v0.3.1.0: Auto-play and file logging are now on by default, /mjadv session starts a clean logged session, and /mjadv bundle packages the recent JSONL logs, config, layouts, Dalamud log tail and a full last-read snapshot into one zip. Status changes are now logged as auto-status records. v0.3.0.1: Re-arm auto-play on a state change even when the hand happens to repeat, and wait for the Riichi/Pass prompt to close before cutting the riichi tile. v0.3.0.0: Optional auto-play. Replays the client's FireCallback protocol for discards, calls, riichi, ron/tsumo and result advancement, using the reference solver's live-verified handshake and timing guards. Off by default; /mjadv auto [on/off] or /mjadv stop toggles it. Pon/ron/tsumo/riichi are enabled by default, chi and kan are opt-in, the chi shape picker pauses for a manual choice, and the new-hand screen is never auto-advanced. Added /mjadv hand and /mjadv options diagnostics. v0.2.0.2: Keep the previous wall count, so the wall-jump half of new-hand detection actually fires. v0.2.0.1: Reset the pond baselines at the start of a new hand, so the first discard of the hand is tracked and the first call prompt gets the right claimed tile. v0.2.0.0: Meld containers now read by default (112-115 families), with a fail-closed check against our own called-meld count. Own meld tiles are recovered from hand deltas when nodes are unavailable, so ukeire no longer counts tiles already in a call. Riichi detection is marker-node only; the dead rotation and score-drop paths are gone. One node-tree walk per read instead of up to seven. Fixed dead hands getting a nonzero win rate and Pass inventing a yaku path. Red-five decoding accepts both absolute and alias ids. Removed the obsolete fold-threshold setting. Setup window no longer reopens every launch. Added /mjadv melds diagnostics and richer log records.

plugins.Author: Akari
plugins.Name: Private Roulette
plugins.Description: Personal dealer-hosted gil roulette: provably-fair control spins, live web players, chat announcements and a dealer console worth watching. Whitelisted to authorized dealers only.

plugins.Author: dexcss
plugins.Name: Glamour Sorter
plugins.Description: Sorts glamour-able gear from your inventory into the Glamour Dresser — outfit sets as outfit glamours (including seasonal sets, with the Store as Outfit Glamour checkbox dialog automated) and loose items one by one — skipping anything already stored. Includes an extractor that withdraws dresser items back to your bags: all loose items, duplicates only, or one item type such as all rings. Open your Glamour Dresser, run /gsort, review the preview, then store.
plugins.Changelog: v1.3.0.19: Spare copies are no longer planned as stores — a piece whose appearance is already in the dresser is dropped from the set plan and reported as a duplicate (the bag copy can be sold), which also removes the HQ leftovers that made the game refuse outfit stores. Skipped sets are always reported now (1.3.0.18 dropped them from the result list), and the plan card note text is fixed. v1.3.0.18: Outfit stores now hand in NQ pieces only — every HQ hand-in made the game refuse the combination silently (all successful stores in the 21:15-21:30 run used NQ pieces, all refusals involved HQ). HQ-only sets are reported as "the dresser will not take HQ gear as an outfit glamour" instead of failing after a click. Slot diagnostics also show each planned piece's quality. v1.3.0.17: Failed outfit stores now report the game's own reason — chat messages printed during the attempt are logged under "game said:" and the result reads "The game did not accept this outfit (left for manual review)", so the remaining refusals can be identified exactly instead of guessed. v1.3.0.16: Confirmation now clicks the real Yes button first (what a player does), then falls back to callback event 2 and event 0 in stages — the seasonal dialog was closing without depositing when only callbacks were fired. Combined with 1.3.0.15, "already in the stored outfit" is reported as ALREADY and is no longer counted as a store. v1.3.0.15: Honest results — "Already in the stored outfit — nothing to add" is now its own ALREADY state and no longer counts as a successful store; the tally reads stored / already there / need attention / failed. The store step also logs the click and, if no confirmation opens within 2 s, fires the addon's Store as Glamour callback (18) before giving up. v1.3.0.14: Diagnosis + fallback for the seasonal Outfit Glamour Creation stalls — the store step now logs the addon state, hand-in counts and every slot (item id, inventory type, flag), and if no confirmation opens within 2 s it fires the addon's Store as Glamour callback (18) as a fallback. v1.3.0.13: Quality consistency for outfit hand-ins — the outfit window only accepts pieces of one quality ("Only items of the same quality may be selected") and a mixed HQ/NQ selection made the game silently refuse the store while leaving the window open. The plugin now anchors on the quality it holds most of and hands in only pieces of that quality, logging any piece skipped for quality. v1.3.0.12: Checkbox-dialog fix — the confirm ladder now ticks the "Store as Outfit Glamour" checkbox first (synthetic ButtonClick + SetChecked) and fires Yes once the game enables it, instead of firing the default-confirm callback first, which closed the dialog without depositing on several sets (the "checkbox was never selected" symptom). The default-confirm callback is kept as a fallback for dialogs whose Yes cannot be enabled from the checkbox. v1.3.0.11: Cross-set outfit mismatch guard — a glamour piece can belong to more than one outfit set, and the game may open a different set's stored outfit when completing; the plugin now compares the opened outfit's item id with the planned set and skips with "left for manual review" instead of handing the piece into the wrong outfit and reporting a false failure. The store log keeps the dialog mode and prism-box index so any remaining case is diagnosable. v1.3.0.10: Fix the "No deposit detected" failures on outfit completions. The hand-in loop was allowed to target a slot already marked Filled (the outfit already contained that piece), which the game silently refused; it now only hands into Unfilled slots, and a set whose planned pieces are all already inside the outfit reports "Already in the stored outfit — nothing to add" instead of attempting a store. The native StoreExistingOutfit retry from 1.3.0.9 is removed — it returns success but deposits nothing unless the Glamour Creation window drives it. v1.3.0.9: Fix false "No deposit detected" results when completing an outfit — the game's confirm dialog sometimes closes without depositing for outfits that were only just created. After 1.5 s without a change the plugin now sends the same request the dialog sends (StoreExistingOutfit/StoreNewOutfit) once, then re-checks; store logs also report the dialog mode and prism-box index for diagnosis. v1.3.0.8: Withdraw tab clarity — the action buttons now state what they will do and grey out with an explicit empty-state label: "No duplicates to withdraw", "No singles to withdraw", and "No sets to withdraw & re-deposit" when there is nothing to pack (otherwise "Withdraw & re-deposit sets (N)" with counts). The consolidation description now explains the withdraw-then-pack-as-outfit loop and the slot saving. v1.3.0.7: Fix a window render crash when the set-consolidation loop ran with no loose set pieces left to start (the empty candidate list was indexed directly) — it now reports "Nothing to consolidate" instead. The consolidation pump is also exception-guarded so a future error cannot take the whole window down. v1.3.0.6: Set consolidation now runs in bag-sized batches — it withdraws one set's loose pieces (only as many as your free bag slots can hold), stores that set as a single outfit glamour, then repeats automatically. Before this the button tried to withdraw every loose set piece at once (359 items against 63 free slots) and was refused. v1.3.0.5: Dresser-full handling — at 800/800 the store run now stops with a clear 'Glamour Dresser is full' result instead of failing every remaining item with 'no deposit detected'. New "set pieces stored loose" detector on the Withdraw tab: it finds items the dresser stores individually that belong to an outfit set, shows how many pieces/sets and the approximate slots that would be freed, withdraws them (arm-then-confirm), then automatically runs the store pass that packs each set into one outfit glamour. v1.3.0.4: Single-item deposits now work — loose glamour items (not part of an outfit set) are stored with the game's own prism-box request command (the same request the Glamour Creation window's Yes button sends) instead of trying to open the outfit-store window, which the game only opens for set items. Each item costs one glamour prism (checked first) and the result reports "Stored item (dresser X->Y)". Outfit sets keep the existing flow. v1.3.0.3: Withdraw fix — the extractor was waiting on the dresser's 'requested' flag, which stays set while the data is loaded, so a run could stop before sending anything ("the dresser data stayed busy"); it now only gates on the loaded flag and retries refused sends. Store: the hand-in window is allowed to finish populating before the fill step decides nothing can be handed over. UI: two pages — Deposit (scan/store) and Withdraw (extractor) — with Abort reachable on the active page. v1.3.0.2: Gear-set protection hardening — items saved in a gear set are now detected from the saved gearset entries as well as the game's gear-set icon check (a 1.3.0.0 test scan saw 110 protected pieces on one pass and only 1 on another, so a piece could be misfiled as sortable). Deposit verification now reads the dresser list from MirageManager, so a dresser window that is momentarily unreadable no longer turns a successful deposit into a false "couldn't read the dresser" warning. v1.3.0.1: Fixes from the first 1.3.0.0 test. The dresser's "Add to pre-existing outfit glamour?" Yes/No prompt (shown when completing a stored outfit) is now answered automatically — before this it left the store flow stuck with the prompt on screen and froze the run. The Abort button stays clickable while a run is in progress. New watchdogs stop a set whose store window never opens or never produces its confirmation instead of stalling the rest of the run. Extractor: a refused RestorePrismBoxItem is retried (the client briefly refuses while a previous restore settles), waits for the dresser data request to finish, and skips further copies of a unique item (the game cannot give you a second copy while you hold one) instead of stopping the whole run; log lines now name the refused item. v1.3.0.0: Loose items — glamour-able items that belong to no outfit set are now stored as well, one at a time, and skipped when that item is already anywhere in the dresser. Extractor — withdraw dresser items back into your bags: all loose items, duplicates only (keeps one of each), or one item or item type such as all rings, with a live progress line. Item names and icons — planned pieces, duplicates and results now show the item icon, name and category instead of a raw item id. v1.2.0.1: Audit fixes. Completing an existing outfit works again — the pieces a stored outfit is still missing are planned as needed and are no longer listed as sellable duplicates. Deposit verification also accepts the planned pieces leaving your bags, so completing an outfit (or storing with a nearly full dresser) reports correctly instead of "No deposit detected". Store steps can no longer drop a set silently when a window does not open or the dresser closes mid-run, the store loop retries briefly while the dresser data reloads instead of stopping the rest of the run, and the Armoire toggle is locked while storing. /xllog now logs the scanned dresser/held counts for troubleshooting. v1.2.0.0: Full audit. Gear-set protection — pieces registered to a saved gear set are now left in your bags (the same check the game uses for its gear-set icon mark), instead of being pulled out of your gear sets. Smarter duplicates — stored outfit glamours are expanded into their pieces, so a second copy of an already-stored piece is flagged as sellable instead of being re-stored. The dresser's expanded item list is scanned, and a never-fill guard skips window slots the game already marks as part of the stored outfit. New model-duplicate hints show when a planned piece shares its appearance with something already stored. Deposit verification now retries briefly instead of failing on a single read. UI: version in the title, live progress tally while storing, MANUAL tag priority, gear-set and model-duplicate sections. Removed diagnostic logging. v1.1.1.0: The Store as Outfit Glamour checkbox dialog is now automated (synthetic checkbox click + default-confirm callback); all sets route to the dresser. v1.1.0.0: Armoire routing added.

plugins.Author: Akari
plugins.Name: Housing Unlocked
plugins.Punchline: See every snap before it happens.
plugins.Description: Housing placement toolkit for FFXIV. See the snap before you place: floor distance measured from the item's own collision data, item-to-item ranges from each item's SphereCastRange, wall attachment from the receiver's own snap walls (partitions, stage panels, house walls), and tabletop surfaces from TableTop collision. Full position/rotation control on top, inherited from BDTH by LeonBlade. Open with /hu. ⚠ Under active testing — not a fully working product yet; features may be incomplete or behave unexpectedly.
